theme: Pièces auto : commande en gros et retours

accroche.en: I want to order twenty sets of brake pads. What is your best wholesale price?
accroche.fr: Je veux commander vingt jeux de plaquettes de frein. Quel est votre meilleur prix de gros ?

dialogue.en: Good morning. I need twenty sets of brake pads for Toyota Corolla and Hyundai Accent.
Original or aftermarket? Original is 25,000 CFA, aftermarket is 15,000 CFA.
Are the aftermarket ones compatible with both models?
Yes, they are compatible. For twenty sets, I can do 13,000 CFA each.
What is the delivery time to Thies?
Three days. I need a deposit of 30 percent.
And if some pieces are defective?
You can return them within seven days. I will give you an invoice.
Deal. I will send the deposit by Wave today.

pratique_micro: Are they compatible with this model?
What is your return policy for defective parts?

defi.en: Order ten batteries. Ask for compatibility, a wholesale price, a deposit amount and the return policy.
defi.fr: Commande dix batteries. Demande la compatibilité, un prix de gros, le montant de l'acompte et la politique de retour, en anglais.

evaluation.q: How do you ask about the time before you receive the goods?
I need a ___ of 30 percent before delivery.

recap: Tu sais vérifier la compatibilité, négocier une commande en gros, fixer un acompte et exiger une politique de retour.
